title: Export Promotion
definition: Export promotion encompasses strategic government policies, institutional mechanisms, financial incentives, and infrastructural interventions designed to stimulate a country's outbound shipments, enhance global market competitiveness, and earn foreign exchange.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Prelims (schemes, institutions, trade definitions, WTO compatibility) and Mains GS Paper 3 (Growth, Development, Export-led growth strategy, Foreign Trade Policy, logistics, and manufacturing competitiveness).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Export Promotion.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
